pages.en:
KIDNAPPING CASE.

The Eastern Times published the following
report on November 12:-

Sung Koo Ku (孫可久), the seven-year-old
grandson of Sung Fang San (孫方三), residing at Sung Ka
Daung (孫家塘) in the 2nd District of the Shanghai
Hsien Government, was kidnapped five days ago.

A letter was received from the bandits
yesterday who demand a very large sum of money for the
ransom of the unfortunate boy. Herewith are the bandits'
stipulations:-

With the next three days, a room will be provided
by the boy's family on the 3rd floor of the Dah
Chung Hwa Hotel (大中華飯店), corner of Foochow
and Thibet Roads. The words "Wang Kwei Sung"
(王桂生) are to be written on the signboard
outside the room as the secret sign.

It is reported that $10,000 is the sum
demanded by the kidnappers.

Owing to the poverty of Sung Fang San who
is a farmer by profession, the matter has been reported
to the Public Safety Bureau for investigation and arrest
of the kidnapper.
pages.zh:
绑架案。

《时报》于11月12日刊登了以下报道：

居住在上海县政府第二区孙家塘（Sung Ka Daung）的孙方三（Sung Fang San）之七岁孙子孙可久（Sung Koo Ku），于五天前被绑架。

昨日收到绑匪来信，索要巨额赎金以赎回这名不幸的男孩。现将绑匪的要求列下：

在接下来的三天内，男孩家属需在大中華飯店（Dah Chung Hwa Hotel，福州路与西藏路转角）三楼提供一个房间。房间外的招牌上需写上“王桂生”（Wang Kwei Sung）字样作为秘密暗号。

据报道，绑匪索要的金额为10,000元。

由于孙方三职业为农，家境贫寒，此事已报请公安局进行调查并逮捕绑匪。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT

File No._______
Louza Station,
Date 12th Nov. 19 31

Subject (in full) Re attached.

Made by D.I. Hall, Forwarded by A. O'Dwyer. C.I.

Assistance was rendered to the Chinese Authorities on the
10-11-31 when two C.D.Cs. were detailed to wait in the Great China
Hotel together with Police from the 2nd Branch Public Safety Bureau.
Two C.D.Cs. have attended there since, but on sending a relief
this a.m. it was found that the Press had somehow received
information of their arrangements and in this morning's copy of the
S Poa (时报), mention was made of them, thus nullifying them and
all detectives have now been withdrawn.

（左侧批注：Copy newspaper attached）

D.E. Cruino
Sir
The premises were raided by our Detectives
but none of the wanted men were there, but
at the request of the Chinese Authorities, we
had the room watched until the report was
seen in the newspaper.

R.J. Cronin
D.P.O.A

O.C. S.B.
Please send one
of your men to find out
where they obtained the
news.
13/11
A. O'D

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
报告

档案号_______
老闸捕房，
日期 1931年11月12日

事由（全称）关于附件。

由 D.I. Hall 撰写，经 A. O'Dwyer. C.I. 转呈。

1931年11月10日，我方派遣两名华籍探员会同公安局第二分局警员在大中华酒店守候，以此协助中国当局。此后一直有两名华籍探员在那里值守，但今晨派人换班时，发现报界不知何故获悉了他们的部署安排，且今晨出版的《时报》（S Poa）中提到了他们，从而使部署失效，目前所有侦探均已撤离。

（左侧批注：附报纸副本）

D.E. Cruino
先生
我方侦探对该处所进行了突击搜查，但通缉犯均不在场，不过应中国当局请求，我们在报纸上看到相关报道之前，一直派人监视该房间。

R.J. Cronin
代理警务副总巡

特别分署主管
请派你手下的一名人员去查清他们是从何处获得该消息的。
11月13日
A. O'D

Translation of the attached despatch No.554 from the Chief
of the Shanghai Hsien Government.

November (?), 1931.

Police Force,
International Settlement.

Gentlemen,
According to the reports received from Tsao Lieh,
Chief of the 2nd Branch Public Safety Bureau and Bang Chao
Tang, Chief of the 2nd District Peace Maintenance Corps, a
gang of bandits attacked the home of the woman Sung Zao Shih
at Sung Ka Tung in the midnight of the 7th of the present
month, robbed over $100 in cash and carried away with them
a 7 year old boy named Sung Koo Chin (孫可久). Enclosed
in the reports was a note left by the bandits giving the
complainant one week's time to raise $50,000.00 and to send
a man under the assumed name of Wong Kwei-sung (王桂生) to
the 3rd floor of the Great China Hotel in Shanghai to carry
out negotiations.

As the Great China Hotel is under the jurisdiction
of the Municipal Police, we detail our Superintendent Han Hyi
(許毅) to accompany his subordinates to make enquiries and
arrests and also request you to render our men any necessary
assistance.

(Chopped) The seal of Yen Tsang-yu (嚴慎予).

S.S.O.A.
Please assist him
10/11 [Signature]
D.C. (CRIME)

上海县政府县长第554号来文译文。

1931年11月（?）日。

致：
国际租界警务处。

诸位先生，
据公安局第二分局局长曹烈（Tsao Lieh）及第二区保卫团团长庞超堂（Bang Chao Tang）的报告，本月7日午夜，一伙匪徒袭击了位于孙家塘（Sung Ka Tung）的孙赵氏（Sung Zao Shih）住所，抢走现金100余元，并掳走一名名叫孙可久（Sung Koo Chin）的7岁男孩。报告中附有绑匪留下的一张字条，限事主在一周内筹款50,000.00元，并派一名化名王桂生（Wong Kwei-sung）的人前往上海大中华酒店三楼进行谈判。

因大中华酒店属工部局警务处管辖，我局特派督察许毅（Han Hyi）率领下属前往查问并实施逮捕，亦请贵处对我方人员提供必要协助。

（盖章）严慎予（Yen Tsang-yu）印。

高级副警务专员助理
请予以协助
11月10日 [签名]
副警司（罪案组）
